# Anagh K R - Freelance Full-Stack & Flutter Developer in Kerala

> Anagh K R is a freelance Full-Stack Software Engineer and Flutter Developer based in Kerala, India. Specializing in high-performance Flutter mobile apps, custom MERN stack websites, Next.js web applications, and scalable Node.js/NestJS backend architectures for startups, local businesses, and international founders.

## Core Services

- [Web Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/web-development/): Custom, high-speed website and web application development using React, Next.js, and Astro.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/mobile-app-development/): End-to-end iOS and Android mobile app engineering tailored for business scalability.
- [Flutter App Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/flutter-app-development/): High-performance 60fps cross-platform mobile apps with a single, maintainable codebase.
- [MERN Stack Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/mern-stack-development/): Full-stack web applications built with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
- [Next.js Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/nextjs-development/): Server-rendered, edge-optimized, and SEO-first web applications.
- [Node.js Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/nodejs-development/): Scalable REST APIs, microservices, and real-time backend systems.
- [NestJS Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/nestjs-development/): Enterprise-grade modular TypeScript backends and microservice architectures.
- [Laravel Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/laravel-development/): Robust PHP web applications, admin portals, and custom APIs.
- [E-Commerce Development](https://www.anaghkr.in/ecommerce-development/): High-converting online stores with Razorpay, Stripe, and modern checkout systems.
- [Web Design Services](https://www.anaghkr.in/web-design/): Responsive UI/UX design, Figma-to-code conversions, and modern dark-mode branding.
- [Hire Remote Kerala Developer](https://www.anaghkr.in/hire-kerala-developer-remotely/): Dedicated remote software engineering for UAE, Gulf, and international businesses.
